marketing_description: The 4500 Series Sliding Patio Door from United Window & Door features a 71-1/2 in wide by 79-1/2 in tall vinyl door with a 3/40 in thickness, paired with a vinyl frame. This door is designed for right-hand operation and includes two panels with a nailing fin type and tempered glass. The door is finished in a black/white LowE Arg w/J coating and includes a main handle and 1-point mortise locking system.
